dedupe_keys.name: high resolution gridded dataset of china s offshore wind potential and costs under technical change

description: High-resolution gridded dataset of China’s offshore wind potential and costs under technical change is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Kangxin An et al. Assessing the dynamics of offshore wind potential and costs informs low-carbon energy policy decisions and energy modeling, but no open-source, spatial explicit and technologically detailed dataset is available. This study addresses this gap by employing a consistent assessment framework that integrates GIS analysis, a wind reanalysis model, a component-based cost model and scenario analysis. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2025. Formats: NetCDF, GeoTIFF, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 602919600 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
